It was my first time eating a burrito bowl here.
The bottom line is, no matter how much I think about it, I just can't understand the taste at that price.
It looks like it will disappear soon.

I wonder if the name is such a meaningless spelling. The kiosk menu said "Bowl", so it must have been "Bowl".
Well, my guess was that the burrito components were laid out like rice in a bowl, but I was half right, but half wrong.
Even though it was just unwrapped, there was no visible trace of cooking, and I couldn't help but be astonished at the insincere making and the uneven taste.

It looks like barley rice with vegetables, a few pieces of meat, beans, corn, etc. sprinkled on top of the yogurt sauce, but the amount is small and it is really tasteless.
If I were to pick a food that has a similar feel, if you go to a place like a kalguksu restaurant, the barley bibimbap that is served before the meal has a similar texture, but it is 100 times more delicious.
Even that one is free.

Anyway, compared to that, this bowl is like the ingredients moving around separately in your mouth, the taste is not in harmony, the temperature is cold, and the texture is very unpleasant. I am even more angry because the quality and composition are so low that it is not worth the price, and it looks like it took no effort to make.

Even though the taste may not seem that good to Koreans because it is foreign food, the ingredients did not seem particularly expensive or difficult to obtain. So, while eating, I said, "Maybe this is because the restaurant is located in Times Square and the rent is high?" I said that before, but when I tried to write a review, I realized it was a chain restaurant?
As I said before, the labor cost doesn't seem to be much since it's a dish that doesn't require any effort to cook, so I don't understand the price even more.

How can you charge more than 10,000 won for half a plate of beef that looks like it was made from barley bibimbap or food that looks like you could eat it? Is this really food for people to eat?

#Mulrae-dong #Yankee’s Burger and Pizza

“The handmade burger was disappointing at the end”

A day when you suddenly want to eat a well-made hamburger.
When I searched for a burger restaurant I had saved near Yeongdeungpo, I saw Yankee Burger.

I took the subway to visit, but surprisingly, there were no customers and it was quiet.
I knew it was a pretty popular place, but I thought it was a little surprising.

I wanted to eat a lot, so I ordered a double patty with bacon, and to ease my guilt, I asked for coleslaw instead of French fries.
Cola is, of course, Cola.

The interior is hip and nice.
The paintings on the walls have a youthful feel, and the casual tables and chairs are perfect for Mullae's burger restaurant.

The burger is really pretty.
It's not that big, but it has the shape of a puffy brigouche bun and the appetizing patty, cheese, and bacon stick out your tongue.

When I pick up the burger, the grease drips down.
There seems to be quite a bit of oil in the patty.
The fat content of the patty is very important. Because it affects the texture and flavor.
So the more the better, but the cleanup after cooking the patties is important.
It's a shame that this place's patties are left behind.
The oil that flows out of the patty soaks the brioche bread, and the thin and soft bread cannot absorb all of the oil.
The bread gets wet and crumbly.

I really appreciate Patty’s hotness.
It was so delicious that I even burned my tongue as I ate it.
Instead, the liver is weak.
The patty needs to be slightly salted to bring out the flavor of the meat.
A sauce that is not strong does not support the taste.

It's a good place to eat, but there are a few things that are disappointing.
So, won’t the customers be the same as before?

reviews.author: EUNGYONG KIM
reviews.text:
Luxury seafood buffet featuring lobster as the main dish
The price is USD 110 per person, that is, the price in Korean won changes every day depending on the exchange rate.
When my family visited, it was about 144,000 won.
They say it's because of the lobster import price blah blah blah, but I personally don't understand it.
It seems like it's just some kind of marketing aimed at creating a unique image.

Anyway, the price range is just below the buffet level of a luxury hotel.
Satisfaction varies depending on personal preference.
If you like lobster or seafood, you will find this place better than a luxury hotel buffet.
If you like steak more than lobster and feel that the variety of food is important, I think you will prefer a luxury hotel buffet.
My family was satisfied with the former because it was close to the former.

The strength of this place compared to other luxury hotel buffets is
1. The size of the lobsters provided at the steamed lobster corner is quite large. You can enjoy this large steamed lobster in unlimited quantities.
2. If you choose a type, you can enjoy unlimited sushi made on the spot and sashimi sliced ​​on the spot. You can choose from edible fish species such as akami tuna belly and sweet shrimp, and the quality is quite good.
3. If you choose 4 types of seafood such as clams, scallops, live octopus, and dog meat, the raw fish will be cut and brought to your seat on the spot.
4. The mango is immediately cleaned and placed on a plate, and the prepared squeezed fruit juice is fresh and of quite good quality.
5. There aren't a lot of desserts, but the famous Noah Bakery's cakes are really delicious, and Paul Bassett's drinks and gelato are top-notch.
6. In the grill corner, you can choose 3 kinds of ingredients such as lobster, shrimp, king ribs, squid, etc. and grill them and serve them on a plate when you order.
The grill corner is different from a luxury hotel buffet.
It has both advantages and disadvantages.
First of all, the advantage is that apart from steamed lobster, you can also eat unlimited lobster grilled on the grill.
Even in top-class hotel buffets, lobster is usually served either steamed or grilled, which is a clear advantage.
In general, the taste was better when steamed.
The disadvantage of the grill corner is that there are no steaks or lamb ribs... This is the biggest disadvantage compared to luxury hotels.
However, the advantage of grilled king ribs is that they are very delicious.
Personally, the ribs at the grill corner were more delicious than the lobster haha.

You can enjoy everything listed above as much as you want, unlimited amounts of it.
Aside from this, Korean food is also pretty good, but since there are so many things to eat, such as lobster, sushi, and raw fish, I don't have much time for Korean food.

Disadvantages compared to luxury hotel buffets
1. There are no snow crabs.
I think it's a bit disappointing that they give you unlimited lobster, but there's no snow crab or king crab.
2. As I already mentioned when describing the advantages above, there are no lamb ribs or beef steaks in the grill corner. Instead, you can eat grilled lobster, and the grilled king ribs are excellent.

There is no difference in price or menu between weekdays/weekends and lunch/dinner. It's all the same
Adults: $110, Children (36 months - 12 years) $55, Children under 36 months: Free
Of course, highchairs and dishes are provided.
There is a sink in the store where you can wash your hands.
